title: Argentinian Vegan Wrap
description: A flavorful and satisfying vegan wrap inspired by the flavors of Argentina. This recipe combines the tanginess of lemon with the bold taste of winey vegetables.
instructions: Preheat a pan over medium heat.
Add the winey vegetables and cook until tender.
Warm the wrap in the pan.
Spread the lemon juice on the wrap.
Add the cooked winey vegetables on top of the wrap.
Roll up the wrap and serve.
